services.name: Day Sails
services.desc: Choose between a 1.5-hour or 2-hour sailing experience departing from Downtown Seattle or Ballard. Each location offers a different style of sail, from city skyline views to open water, wildlife, and mountain scenery. Our day sails take place aboard 70ft retired ocean racing sailboats and are the longest running sailboat cruises in Seattle, operating since 1984. Guests can choose between two different styles of experience depending on where they depart. Downtown is ideal for classic Seattle skyline views and a lively waterfront feel, while Ballard feels more open and natural, with better chances for wildlife and mountain scenery.
